newsitem.title: CUBA: Ibero-American military officials to meet in Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Ibero-American military officials to meet in Cuba.

text.p: The heads of military academies from 11 Spanish-speaking countries will meet in Havana later this month to promote friendly ties among the academies, a Cuban military officer said on Friday.

Brig. Gen. Oscar Abascal told reporters heads of military academies or in some cases deputy defence ministers from Cuba, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guatemala, Spain, Nicaragua, Ecuatorial Guinea and Mexico would attend the Nov. 25-29 meeting, a rare gathering of foreign military officials in this communist-ruled island.

The meeting, which follows similar conferences in Spain in 1992 and in Argentina in 1994, is to be held just ahead of celebrations in December of the 40th anniversary of Cuba's Revolutionary Armed Forces.

Cuba lost not just its main economic ally but its main defence partner when the former Soviet bloc collapsed. The Soviet Union and its allies supplied much of Cuba's military equipment and also provided training programmes.
